📘 Practice Problems

guide:
Payroll

हर Problem: क्या करना है → Steps → Entry Table → ✅ Check (उत्तर-कुंजी से मिलान)।

सबसे पहले — Payroll की तैयारी

  • F11 (Features) → Maintain Payroll = Yes।
  • Create → Employee Group (जैसे Sales, Marketing, Clerk) और फिर Employee बनाएँ।
  • Create → Pay Head: Basic Salary (Earnings, Flat Rate), HRA/TA/DA (Earnings, As Computed Value — % of Basic), PF/ESI/Professional Tax (Deductions), Overtime/Bonus (Earnings), Leave Deduction (Deductions)।
  • Create → Attendance/Production Type (Days Present, Leave Days, Overtime Hrs) जहाँ ज़रूरी हो।
  • Create → Salary Details: Employee/Group के लिए Effective Date से Pay Heads और रकम भरें।
  • Attendance Voucher में Leave Days/Overtime भरें; फिर Payroll Voucher से माह की Salary Process करें (Gateway → Vouchers → Payroll)।
  • जाँच: Payslip / Payroll Statement।
याद रखें

Net Salary = सभी Earnings − सभी Deductions।

PF Employee Share = Basic का 12%।

ESI Employee Share = 0.75% (Gross ₹21,000/माह तक लागू)।

Attendance Type के बिना Leave/Overtime नहीं चलेगा।

problems.title: ABC Firm — 6 Employees, 3 Departments, Leave + Overtime + Bonus
problems.q:
🔴 Expert

Allowances (% of Basic): HRA 8%, TA 12%, DA 20%। Deductions (Employee Share, % of Basic): PF 12%, ESI 0.75%। Leave Deduction/Day — Sales ₹300, Marketing ₹400, Clerk ₹250। Overtime/Hour — Sales ₹110, Marketing ₹90, Clerk ₹80। Bonus (flat per Employee) — Sales ₹3,000, Marketing ₹4,000, Clerk ₹2,500।

Formula: Net Salary = Basic − Leave Deduction + Overtime + Bonus + HRA + TA + DA − PF − ESI। (ध्यान दें: असल में ESI तभी लागू है जब Gross ₹ 21,000/माह तक हो; यहाँ अभ्यास के लिए सब पर लगाएँ।)
